name: DaisySP modules
author: Electrosmith (DaisySP); wrapper by dawlings
description: Rack modules built on the DaisySP DSP library.

provides.title: ENV
provides.blurb: An ADSR envelope opened by a gate.

provides.title: VCO
provides.blurb: A band-limited oscillator: sine, triangle, saw, pulse.

provides.title: DRUM
provides.blurb: A kick, snare or hat voice, struck by a trigger.

provides.title: SVF
provides.blurb: A state-variable filter: low, band, high and notch together.

provides.title: LADDER
provides.blurb: A Moog-style ladder filter that sings when pushed.

provides.title: FOLD
provides.blurb: A wavefolder: harmonics from folding the wave back on itself.

provides.title: DRIVE
provides.blurb: Soft overdrive.

provides.title: CRUSH
provides.blurb: Sample-rate and bit reduction.

provides.title: DELAY
provides.blurb: A stereo echo: free or tied to the song's tempo, with a ping-pong.

provides.title: CHORUS
provides.blurb: Thickens a sound with a slow, swimming copy of itself.

provides.title: OUT
provides.blurb: The output: to the speakers, and out of the room to a track.

provides.title: PHASER
provides.blurb: Sweeps notches through a sound for a slow, swirling whoosh.

provides.title: FLANGER
provides.blurb: A short, swept delay that sounds like a jet passing: combs sliding through a sound.

provides.title: TREMOLO
provides.blurb: Makes a sound swell and dip in volume, steadily.

provides.title: AUTOWAH
provides.blurb: A filter that opens and closes with how loudly you play: wah-wah without a pedal.

provides.title: PITCH
provides.blurb: Moves a sound up or down in pitch without changing its speed.

provides.title: LIMIT
provides.blurb: Pushes a sound up and stops its peaks from going over: louder without clipping.

provides.title: SOAP
provides.blurb: A band filter with a pass output and a reject output: keep one band, or cut it out.

provides.title: AD
provides.blurb: A one-shot envelope: up in the attack time, down in the decay time, each trigger.

provides.title: COIN
provides.blurb: A coin toss for every trigger: it lets a gate through or holds it back, by chance.

provides.title: WANDER
provides.blurb: A smoothly wandering random level: a slow, drifting change that never repeats.

provides.title: FM
provides.blurb: Two sine waves, one bending the pitch of the other: bells, basses and metal.

provides.title: FORMANT
provides.blurb: A voice-like oscillator: a resonant peak you can slide, as in vowels.

provides.title: VOSIM
provides.blurb: A buzzy, vocal oscillator made of squared sine pulses: robot voices and throaty basses.

provides.title: SHAPER
provides.blurb: One oscillator that slides from a saw, through a triangle, to a pulse as you turn the shape.

provides.title: VARISAW
provides.blurb: A saw with a notch and a ramp you can bend: bright, hollow and in between.

provides.title: ZOSC
provides.blurb: A windowed-sine oscillator with a sweepable formant: sharp, nasal and synthetic.

provides.title: ADDITIVE
provides.blurb: Sixteen sine harmonics added together: sculpt a tone by choosing which overtones ring.

provides.title: ORGAN
provides.blurb: Seven saw and square waves an octave apart, mixed by hand: strings and organ pads.

provides.title: DUST
provides.blurb: Random clicks, some loud and some soft, as often as you ask: crackle, rain and random triggers.

provides.title: STEPNOISE
provides.blurb: Noise that changes only at a set rate: stepped random levels, or a buzzy, gritty tone when fast.

provides.title: PARTICLE
provides.blurb: A shower of tiny pings: dripping, sparkling, rattling, from a few to a swarm.

provides.title: GRAINLET
provides.blurb: A pitched, formant oscillator made of sine grains: vocal, plucky and smeared.

provides.title: FRACTAL
provides.blurb: Layered noise from slow to fast: wind, rumble and hiss, with a colour that goes dark to bright.

provides.title: SYNKICK
provides.blurb: A kick drum built from a falling sine, a click and a dab of noise: punchy and tuneable.

provides.title: SYNSNARE
provides.blurb: A snare from a pitched shell and a rattle of noise: crack, snap and body.

provides.title: MODAL
provides.blurb: A struck bar, bell or glass: a voice built from a few ringing resonances.

provides.title: STRING
provides.blurb: A plucked string: guitar, harp and zither, from a trigger and a pitch.

provides.title: KARPLUS
provides.blurb: A string with no pluck: feed it a click, a burst of noise or a drum to make it ring at a pitch.

provides.title: RESON
provides.blurb: Makes any sound ring like a struck object: a bar, a plate or a tube, at the pitch you give it.

provides.title: DRIP
provides.blurb: A bubbling water drop for every trigger.
